text: Implemented dynamic script tags, property-backed grapheme/bidi itemization, contextual NativeFont.shapeRange with global source clusters, explicit whole-item/whole-atom fallback, immutable unwrapped ParagraphLayout and exact recording. Integrated one ICU4X Rust library with C/C++ font libraries in isolated probeParagraph. Eight native integration tests passed after correcting a fixture that all supplied fonts lacked; added RTL mirrored-punctuation and ligature/missing-text assertions for final full verification. Mixed Latin/Greek/Arabic/Hebrew/Devanagari shaping, partial within-item fallback, unsplittable missing mark clusters, ownership and budgets covered. Full testJVM/testNative/font/Unicode/paragraph run now pending.
